info.title: Montana Frozen Foods — Website API
info.description: Public API for montanaeg.com, the corporate site of Montana Frozen Foods (Egyptian IQF vegetable and fruit exporter, est. 1985). The API currently exposes a single endpoint for submitting a business or trade inquiry to the sales team. Product and company information is published as regular HTML pages — see https://montanaeg.com/sitemap.xml for the full list of localized pages.

post.description: Sends an inquiry to the Montana sales team by email. No authentication is required. `cfToken` carries a Cloudflare Turnstile token when the request originates from the website form; other clients may omit it. Send only the documented fields.

200.description: Inquiry accepted and forwarded to the sales team.

400.description: Validation failed. The response lists per-field errors, or `{"error": "captcha"}` when Turnstile verification fails, or `{"error": "invalid json"}` for a malformed body.

502.description: The inquiry was valid but the outbound email could not be delivered. Retry later or email info@montanaeg.com directly.

name.description: Full name of the person or agent principal making the inquiry.

email.description: Reply-to email address. Responses from the sales team go here.

subject.description: Inquiry category. Use `export` for international trade and distribution, `sales` for orders and pricing.

consent.description: Confirmation that the sender consents to Montana processing this data to answer the inquiry (see https://montanaeg.com/en/privacy). Must be true.

cfToken.description: Cloudflare Turnstile response token. Only present for submissions from the website form.
